description: This file defines the ICacheMonitor interface, which specifies methods for monitoring cache metrics such as pressure status, message counts, memory usage, and cache size within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: ICacheMonitor
classes.description: Interface for monitoring cache-related metrics, including pressure status, message counts, memory allocation, and cache size reporting.

methods.name: TrackCachePressureMonitorStatusChange
methods.description: Tracks changes in cache pressure status, including pressure type, pressure state, contribution count, current pressure, and flow control threshold.

methods.name: TrackMessagesAdded
methods.description: Records the number of messages added to the cache.

methods.name: TrackMessagesPurged
methods.description: Records the number of messages purged from the cache.

methods.name: TrackMemoryAllocated
methods.description: Tracks memory allocation in bytes for the cache.

methods.name: TrackMemoryReleased
methods.description: Tracks memory released back to the block pool in bytes.

methods.name: ReportMessageStatistics
methods.description: Reports cache message timing statistics and total message count.

methods.name: ReportCacheSize
methods.description: Reports the total cache size in bytes.
